subject: Fire Department Overtime and Chief Selection
overview: A news report covers a Medford City Council meeting addressing allegations of sick time abuse within the fire department and the selection process for a new fire chief. The City Council voted to refer the fire chief appointment matter to committee.

items.title: Fire Department Sick Leave and Overtime Investigation
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn raised concerns over an investigation into 21 firefighters calling out sick during a single Saturday day shift, incurring nearly $100,000 in overtime costs, which union leadership defended as a contractual right.

items.title: Fire Chief Selection Process
items.summary: The City Council addressed the search for a new fire chief amidst disagreement between the mayor, who favors external management oversight, and the firefighters' union, which advocates hiring internally. The council voted to refer the matter to committee.
